Subject: your intake coordinator role

Hi Fiona,

Noticed Calloway Grant is hiring an intake coordinator to run new-client calls and conflict checks. More intake usually means more client detail passing through more tools.

We built an AI legal assistant platform for research and document help for a legal-tech venture.

Worth a look?

Sam
Nextron AI

If you'd rather not hear from me, reply "stop" and I won't email again. Privacy notice: https://www.example.com/nextron/privacy

Could something like this remove the manual steps between our web enquiry form and the conflict check, or is it only for research and documents?

Fiona
